_comment: Stellix, tailored from docs/project.md (surveyed 2026-10-26, branch work/notes-hit, b41d77d). Complete: packs add no default folders. stage-guard is disabled: the house git-guard already refuses git add -A. 0.4.0: the SOUND and MIXER layers (lib/app/src/layer*, cards, controls) are UI, so the control and look rules load there; confirm against the re-survey. 0.6.0: the copy trees are folders of kind copy (protect-vendor guards them; copy-tree-guard.py is merged into it), and guards carries Stellix's values for the house guards. enable: the opt-in hooks Stellix runs (tims-asks, idle-wake); guards.git.refuseTrunk: Stellix works on a branch per step.

app.purpose: the standalone, processor, editor, player, demo and the one launch function (launch.cpp)

app_copy.purpose: a COPY TREE (kind copy): Tabula 1's PIANO loader, bridge and prebuild tool, copied unchanged by tools/copy_tabula.py; read-only as every copy tree

snapshot.purpose: the one shared snapshot header the painter reads (header-only)

world.purpose: the world: travellers, strikes, rebounds, PULL, walls, the snapshot ring, State and the seeded RandomSource

engines.purpose: SlotSound and Tabula 1's voice, copied and proved (src/tabula is read-only)

engines_copy.purpose: a COPY TREE (kind copy): Tabula 1's voice, effects and dspblocks files, copied unchanged by tools/copy_tabula.py; read-only (L8), each file with its origin line

engines_own.purpose: PROMOTED files (kind own): copied files that measured identical, moved out of the copy tree by tools/copy_promote.py with their .origin record; these may be changed

dsp.purpose: effects and dynamics: delay, EQ, compressor, limiter (S11a-S11d)

painter.purpose: everything drawn: scene, camera, card, GPU layer, shaders, the Painter facade

records.purpose: data/records (fixed ids, moons) and data/bank (factory patches)

probes.purpose: probe executables, each with --selftest, and the shot program (pictures, benches)

docs.purpose: spec, delay spec, laws, licences, research, work order (plan and logs at the root: build.md, bugs.md, workflow-bugs.md)

tools.purpose: build.sh, step.py, gates/, hooks/, plants.sh and plants.d/, copy and compare tools

audio-entry.what: processBlock and the processor, voices, sound and mixer

world.what: travellers, strikes, rebounds, PULL, walls, the world step, the snapshot ring, seeded random

snapshot.what: the one plain-data snapshot type the painter reads

engine.what: SlotSound and the copied Tabula voice (src/tabula is read-only)

dsp-block.what: effects and dynamics: delay, EQ, compressor, limiter

gpu-code.what: anything that calls Dawn/WebGPU, the scene, camera, card, Painter facade

editor.what: the editor, live view and UI wiring

probe.what: a probe executable with --selftest, the shot program

docs.what: spec, laws, licences, research, work orders

tools.what: build.sh, step.py, gates, hooks, copy and compare tools

git.branchStart: python3 tools/step.py start <STEP> "task" (work that is not a step: start --work <name> "task")

time.saveCommand: add new files by path, then python3 tools/step.py save "<note>"
